messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: external pen test inbound next week. Assessor asked for scope sheet, RBAC mapping for readroom access, and KMS-wrapped evidence upload instructions. Need short sync on evidence upload process and retest availability.

devon: Who's the assessor? drop contact so I can pre-create temporary roles.

maria: DM sent. They want ephemeral creds + presigned S3 uploads. Prefer client-side encrypted blobs using our KMS.

chris: Presigned uploads are fine. We'll restrict uploads to a dedicated evidence bucket and apply a write-only presign policy. Propose 90-day retention on artifacts.

samir: 90d OK. Important: do NOT grant kms:Decrypt to the assessor. Have them upload ciphertext only. We can allow GenerateDataKeyEncrypted or Encrypt-only grants.

elaine: Agreed. Plan: create a KMS key granting GenerateDataKeyEncrypted (or Encrypt) scoped to S3 via kms:ViaService, and keep Decrypt limited to our internal readroom account for verification.

maria: Can someone paste a short IAM/KMS snippet we can hand to the assessor to speed provisioning?

devon: Quick snippet (for infra team):
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:Encrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-evidence-key",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
}
```

chris: Add an S3 PutObject condition so only the evidence bucket can be targeted. Also revoke grants after 8h (our default PT window).

samir: For RBAC, we'll create a temporary role named assessor-readroom with session tag TTL = 8h. Permissions: S3:PutObject (prefix-limited), S3:ListBucket (prefix), KMS:Encrypt/GenerateDataKey*, no kms:Decrypt.

maria: Good. On audit logs: assessor asked for proof of CloudTrail exports. Who owns the export? eng-sre?

elaine: Eng-sre can snapshot the CloudTrail S3 prefix at the start of the window and provide a SHA256 hash + presigned link to the snapshot. That proves integrity.

devon: Also enable S3 Object Lock in Governance mode for the evidence bucket for the duration of the engagement to prevent accidental deletion. We can set Governance 30d then lift after retest.

chris: Re retest windows: assessor proposed two 4-hour slots Tue/Thu. I suggest Tue 14:00-18:00 PST and Thu 09:00-13:00 PST. Any conflicts?

samir: Oncall has an unrelated drill Tue morning but should be OK. Mark Thu as primary and Tue as fallback.

maria: I'll propose Thu as primary. Can someone create a tracker ticket that links scope, artifacts, roles, and timelines?

devon: Creating ticket now: PT-4712. Checklist I'm adding: create evidence bucket, enable object lock, provision KMS key, create assessor-readroom role, generate presigned upload URLs, take CloudTrail snapshot + hash, produce a short readroom process doc.

elaine: Add SIEM step: tag any assessment-generated alerts with label pt:external so oncall won't escalate them accidentally.

chris: Also add a rollback play in case scans are noisy: oncall runbook will isolate staging, pause traffic, and open a bridge.

incident-bot: Reminder: create bridge 15 minutes before scheduled window. Use `/bridge open pt-assessment` to create the channel and dial-in.

maria: Need volunteers for evidence coordinator during the window. I'll cover first two hours on Thu; need backup for remainder.

devon: I'll be backup. chris owns the CloudTrail snapshot and will produce the hash.

samir: I'll own role provisioning and KMS grant lifecycle; will PR a Terraform module with TTL=8h.

maria: Thanks. Last item: retest validation. After assessor confirms fixes, we schedule a 1-hour retest within one week. Add acceptance criteria: proof of fix, regenerated evidence hash, and SIEM verification showing no alerts for impacted host IDs.

devon: Added acceptance criteria to PT-4712. Also: do not share raw keys or Decrypt privileges in Slack. Use secure docs (Okta docs) for any secret exchange.

chris: Small ops note: ensure S3 bucket policies restrict uploads to presigned URLs only and block public ACLs. We'll instrument CloudWatch metrics for unusual upload rates.

maria: I'll DM the assessor the presigned upload instructions and the minimal policy snippet once infra is ready. Tagging: @devon @samir @chris @elaine.

elaine: ACK :white_check_mark:

devon: ACK :thumbsup:

samir: ACK 7h PR incoming before EOD.

maria: Timeline recap: TF PRs from samir/devon today, eng-sre log snapshot prep tomorrow, evidence bucket + roles up by Wed, primary window Thu 09:00-13:00 PST, 1-week follow-up retest.

maria: (end)
